## Data sources

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Draft (chat)** — from `docs/data-sources.md`. The author's edit is in Week 20.
:::

- **Tiger population.** National Tiger Conservation Authority and Wildlife
  Institute of India, All India Tiger Estimation reports, 2006–2022
  (<https://ntca.gov.in>). Government of India. The census series of this
  project is the within-reserve estimate of 2014, 2018 and 2022.
- **Reserve and corridor outlines.** National Tiger Conservation Authority
  (2022), *PA_TR_Corridor_Final* (KML), Decision Support System
  (<https://ntca.gov.in/dss/>). Government of India; attribution required.
  The outlines are the core protected areas, not the notified area of the
  reserve.
- **Reserve area.** The NTCA-notified core and buffer total of each reserve.
- **Tiger records.** GBIF.org (2026-09-07), GBIF Occurrence Download,
  <https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.npxmxx>. CC BY or CC0 for each record.
- **Mammal records (the background).** GBIF.org (2026-09-07), GBIF
  Occurrence Download, <https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.2d523e>. CC BY or CC0 for
  each record.
- **Land cover.** ESA WorldCover 2021 v200,
  <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7254221>. CC BY 4.0.
- **Human pressure.** Global Human Modification 2022 (Theobald et al., v3),
  <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14502573>. CC BY 4.0.
- **Roads, settlements and zoos.** OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap
  contributors (ODbL), from the Geofabrik India extract
  (<https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/india.html>).
- **Terrain.** AWS Terrain Tiles (<https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/>).
- **States.** Natural Earth admin-1 boundaries (public domain).
- **Districts.** DataMeet Census-2011 districts (CC BY 4.0).
- **Forest (a cross-check of the reserve area only).** Forest Survey of
  India, India State of Forest Report 2021 (<https://fsi.nic.in>).
